name: Container Ship Feeder
summary: A feeder container ship with coloured stacked containers, stern bridge and funnel.
description: A fictional feeder container ship with stacked coloured containers, weathered hull plating and a stern bridge. Simplified procedural geometry intended for gallery and game use.
author: Blender-3D-Gallery original procedural modeling
creation_method: Deterministic Blender Python geometry with procedural node-baked hull colour and roughness maps; no downloaded assets.
rights: Original project asset; redistribution terms for public downloads are not specified.
accuracy_notes: Generic, simplified fictional vessel. Hull length 170 m and beam 27 m; 1 Blender unit = 1 m; Blender +X bow, +Z up, waterline Z=0 and origin at waterline amidships. glTF +X bow, +Y up, waterline Y=0. No real vessel represented; not an engineering or navigational model.

attribution.credit: Original procedural geometry and materials; no external model or texture.

verification.preview_review: PASS: three iterative side, three-quarter and bridge preview reviews; simplified features remain
